title: Nine Days of Nothing
subtitle: 情绪与情感 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情绪与情感（人与自我·情绪与情感）
meta: 主题语境：情绪与情感（人与自我·情绪与情感）　|　核心词汇：anger　|　正文 331 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 anger 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 my father wrote a letter and did not send it, and my mother said the ① anger in it was the only thing in the house anybody ever counted. He said nothing ② in anger for forty-one years, which my grandmother said was not a virtue but a habit, and she said habits are the only virtues that last; anger, he said, is the only thing you can write down and never send.

His ③ anger at the council, which began in 1968 and ended in 1984, was the longest thing in his life and the quietest. There was ④ one anger, in 1971, when he broke a chair, and he said breaking a chair is the only anger a man should be allowed, and my mother said he had been allowed it once.

She could ⑤ control her anger for nine days at a time, and she said nine days is the whole of the skill. My brother was ⑥ filled with anger in 1979 at the age of nineteen, and my father said being filled with anger at nineteen is the only kind that is ever useful.

The ⑦ anger of 1984, meaning everybody's and not his, was about a road, and it was the only time the street agreed about anything. What ⑧ angered him most, he said in 1990, was not the road but the fact that the meeting had been polite, and my mother said that was the truest thing he ever said; anger, he said, is what politeness is for.

The  anger I remember is not the chair or the road or the letter, but the nine days in which she said nothing, which were the only days the house was quiet. Anger, my father wrote in 1996, is the only thing a family can keep for forty-one years without anybody once naming it; the  anger of the street in 1984 was the only anger anybody in it ever shared, and no anger of ours has ever been shared at all.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 愤怒；怒气（泛指）
B. n. （一次的）发火；怒气的发作
D. v. 使生气；激怒（anger sb.）
E. 固定搭配：in anger 生气地；愤怒地
F. 固定搭配：anger at / over sth. 对某事的愤怒
G. 固定搭配：control / hold back one's anger 抑制怒气
H. 固定搭配：be filled with anger 满腔怒火

items.q: the anger in it was the only thing
nothing in anger for forty-one years
control her anger for nine days

answers.why: anger 意为“愤怒、怒气”，1970 年父亲写了一封信却没有寄出，母亲说信里的愤怒是屋里唯一被人计算过的东西。
in anger 意为“生气地、愤怒地”，他四十一年里从未在生气时说过一句话。
anger at ... 意为“对某事的愤怒”，他对议会的愤怒始于 1968 年，终于 1984 年。
anger 意为“一次发火”，1971 年他发过一次火，砸了一把椅子。
control one's anger 意为“抑制怒气”，她能把怒气压住九天，她说九天就是这门本事的全部。
be filled with anger 意为“满腔怒火”，1979 年我弟弟十九岁，满腔怒火。
anger 意为“义愤、众怒”，1984 年的那场愤怒指的是大家的愤怒，而不是他一个人的。
anger 作动词，意为“使生气、激怒”，最让他生气的是那场会开得太客气，而不是那条路。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。

他对议会的愤怒始于 1968 年，终于 1984 年，那是他一生中最长也最安静的一件事。（anger at）
1971 年他发过一次火，砸了一把椅子，他说砸椅子是男人唯一被允许的愤怒。（anger）
她能把怒气压住九天，她说九天就是这门本事的全部。（control one's anger）
1990 年他说，最让他生气的不是那条路，而是那场会开得太客气。（anger）
answers: In 1970 my father wrote a letter and did not send it, and my mother said the anger in it was the only thing anybody counted.
He said nothing in anger for forty-one years, and my grandmother said that was a habit and not a virtue.
His anger at the council began in 1968 and ended in 1984, and it was the quietest thing in his life.
There was one anger in 1971, when he broke a chair, and he said it is the only anger a man should be allowed.
She could control her anger for nine days at a time, and she said nine days is the whole of the skill.
What angered him most in 1990, he said, was not the road but the fact that the meeting had been polite.
